scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && rollup -c && node ../../scripts/normalize-declaration-layout.mjs common
scripts.check:agent: tsc src/ai/agent/agent-core.check.ts --rootDir src/ai --outDir .tmp-check --module commonjs --target ES2020 --lib ES2020,DOM --skipLibCheck && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('.tmp-check/package.json', '{\"type\":\"commonjs\"}')" && node --localstorage-file=.tmp-check/localstorage .tmp-check/agent/agent-core.check.js
scripts.check:request: tsc src/utils/request-auth.check.ts --rootDir src/utils --outDir .tmp-check --module commonjs --target ES2020 --lib ES2020,DOM --skipLibCheck && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('.tmp-check/package.json', '{\"type\":\"commonjs\"}')" && node .tmp-check/request-auth.check.js
scripts.check:plugins: tsc src/core/plugin-api-compat.check.ts --rootDir src --outDir .tmp-check/plugins --module commonjs --target ES2020 --lib ES2020,DOM --jsx react --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('.tmp-check/plugins', { recursive: true }); require('fs').writeFileSync('.tmp-check/plugins/package.json', '{\"type\":\"commonjs\"}')" && node .tmp-check/plugins/core/plugin-api-compat.check.js
scripts.check:space-page: tsc src/domain/space-page/ids.check.ts src/domain/space-page/permissions.check.ts src/domain/space-page/change-stream.check.ts src/services/service-resolver.check.ts src/core/service-owner-lifecycle.check.ts --rootDir src --outDir .tmp-check/space-page --module commonjs --target ES2020 --lib ES2020,DOM --jsx react --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('.tmp-check/space-page', { recursive: true }); require('fs').writeFileSync('.tmp-check/space-page/package.json', '{\"type\":\"commonjs\"}')" && node .tmp-check/space-page/domain/space-page/ids.check.js && node .tmp-check/space-page/domain/space-page/permissions.check.js && node .tmp-check/space-page/domain/space-page/change-stream.check.js && node .tmp-check/space-page/services/service-resolver.check.js && node .tmp-check/space-page/core/service-owner-lifecycle.check.js
scripts.check: pnpm check:agent && pnpm check:request && pnpm check:plugins && pnpm check:space-page
